cs.t: I have a custom keyboard from WASD that is mostly* the NeXT layout, and I use Karabiner (macOS) to program it to behave like one. It's wonderful. *The keyboard in the post has | in the right place but all my NeXT keyboards had it in some wackass position over the ten-key. Ridiculous.
cs.th: Reverse engineering the 1988 NeXT keyboard protocol
